<!-- pr-reviewer: bea85a42966cf1e1bc0810a1ad7034d3f7ab5091 -->
Needs changes before merge. There are three requested items below.

This is the first review of this PR. I read the complete diff, including the changes from #4022. I checked the laws on current upstream main. I found no production-code defect in the opening writer.

**Local build and tests**

I tested trial merge `818d748b904fcd366f45a2da6f56e56ac6340e1b` with main `3bb6647f62cb55b8d0b6342afcd9bd18ae4a59de`. Its first parent is the PR head above. No GitHub runner ran.

The cache wrapper made no progress during the initial planner build. I stopped that build. Verification ran with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: the geometry text change selected the batch fallback. All builds passed. Of 1,217 steps, 1,214 passed and three UI suites failed. There were no stalls. The run took 27.1 minutes. Strict clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --only motion --only app`: all 11 light tests passed across five targets. The selection includes every light test. It omits only the broad release prebuild. Cargo built each selected target. No full heavy lane ran.
- Post lib: 159 passed, including all nine `agie::opening_tests` tests.
- `agie_native`: 39 passed. `wire_dxf_selection`: 11 passed. `wire_post_alias`: 6 passed.
- All three `egui_app::tests::agie_post` tests passed.

**Extra suites run**

These suites ran by name in the quick fallback:

- `agie_native`: 39 passed. This suite reads the Agie job golden directory.
- `script_agie_native`: 11 passed. This suite reads the changed refusal directory through `recorded::check`.
- UI lib: ran from `crates/ui`; its Agie dialog tests read the Agie job golden directory.
- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- Kernel `step_agreement`: 29 passed. Kernel `machining_mesh`: 7 passed. App `feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.

No importer code or STEP fixture changed.

**Host failures checked on bare main**

This headless host has no GPU adapter available to the tests. I ran the same three failed UI suites on bare main `3bb6647f6`:

```text
cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test egui_app --test shell --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=16
```

Both trees give these results. All 11 failed test names match exactly.

| Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| UI lib | 1675 | 7 | 8 |
| UI egui_app | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| UI shell | 20 | 1 | 0 |

Six report-picture tests fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The other failures report `no graphics adapter` or the resulting nonzero CLI exit code. These are pre-existing host failures. They do not block this PR. No tracking issue was identified.

**Safety, mutations and goldens**

This is a safety-tier review because the PR adds native EDM output.

I ran these two mutation tests again, explicitly:

- `agie_native::opening::a_small_concave_arc_an_island_or_an_outside_hole_publishes_nothing`: 1 passed. The R0.2 fillet, island and outside-hole inputs are refused. No job is published.
- `wire_dxf_selection::arcs::a_reentrant_die_of_lines_and_arcs_passes_the_laws_and_a_2um_gouge_does_not`: 1 passed. The valid cut passes. The 2 µm arc mutation produces a `Gouge` finding.

I checked the new `REENT20.ISO` golden line by line against the drawing and the writer. The seam, nominal walls, G02/G03 directions and incremental I/J centres agree. The app test checks the SBL against DIE20 with only the stated stem, stock and hole changes. It also checks the SBR.

I checked all 11 changed `.refusal` goldens line by line. Only line 2 changes its diagnostic text. The trace locations stay unchanged. The existing Agie job golden checks pass.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:36` changes visible text. The post name, messages and Wire-page hint also change. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add the screenshots to the body. Store them only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images or review evidence to this PR branch. This item is also open in the parent review of #4022.
2. **Missing process declaration.** `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149` changes a process file. Add the exact line `Process change: yes` to this PR body. Current upstream AGENTS.md requires that line. Do not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; the merging session owns its bump.
3. **Incomplete legacy-project post test.** `crates/app/tests/wire_post_alias.rs:101` calls `script_source()`. It reads CPS text; it does not post a job. Issue #4000 requires an opened legacy project to post and then save the current name. For each old alias, open a valid job, post it to a new directory, and compare its ISO, SBR and SBL files with the unchanged goldens. Then check that the save writes the current name. This item remains open in #4022 and is unchanged in this diff. Bring in the parent fix or add the required coverage here.

The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round. The worktree has no tracked changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Reply to the review of head `bea85a429` (comment 7170791183). The new head is `65ec94c5c`.

**Item 1. Missing UI evidence.**
- The PR body has a new section "Screenshots (review item 1)" with the five before/after pairs of #4022.
- The renamed visible texts come from the parent #4022. This PR adds no UI change: its own commit `bea85a429` changes no file in `crates/ui`.
- The images are only on the fork branch `pr-screenshots`, folder `pr-4022/`. The PR branch has no image.

**Item 2. Missing process declaration.**
- The body has the exact line `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

**Item 3. Incomplete legacy-project post test.**
- The branch now merges the parent fix. The test `agie_native::legacy_name::a_project_saved_with_each_old_name_posts_the_unchanged_job_and_saves_the_new_name` is in this PR.
- For each old post name, the test opens a saved project, posts it to a new directory, and compares the ISO, SBR and SBL files with the unchanged goldens. Then it checks that the save writes the new name.
- The "Pinning tests" section of the body names it.

**Refresh.**
- Merge commits `c7934501f` and `2f6476301` merge the #4022 branch, now at `87805dcf9`. That head has `origin/main` at `83d52ef6a` and the conflict resolution of #4022.
- Merge commit `65ec94c5c` merges `origin/main` at `aef12fea6`. That main has the `wire_post` build fix of #4058.
- The only conflict was in `crates/app/tests/agie_native.rs` (in `c7934501f`). The resolution keeps the module lines of both sides.
- The own commit of this PR is still the one feature commit `bea85a429`.

**Gate on `65ec94c5c`:**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: batch fallback (the diff touches `crates/geometry`). 1217 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 40.7 min.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Ready for a re-check.
